title: FoldPipe: Bounded Remote Streaming of Native Molecular Shards with Asynchronous Prefetch
abstract: arXiv:2608.27029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training molecular machine-learning models on ephemeral or memory-constrained accelerator instances can require repeatedly retrieving preprocessed molecular graphs from remote storage. FoldPipe is a lightweight Python orchestration layer for already-sharded PyTorch and PyTorch Geometric data. It retrieves one shard ahead in a background thread while the consumer trains on the current shard, keeping the number of live shard payloads bounded with respect to total dataset size.   Asynchronous prefetch and bounded buffering are established systems techniques rather than novel scheduling algorithms. FoldPipe's contribution is a small integration targeted at native .pt molecular shards together with a source-pinned empirical characterization of its operating regime. translated_title: FoldPipe：基于异步预取的原生分子分片有界远程流式处理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27029v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在临时或内存受限的加速器实例上训练分子机器学习模型，可能需要从远程存储中反复检索预处理的分子图。FoldPipe是一个轻量级的Python编排层，适用于已分片的PyTorch和PyTorch Geometric数据。它在后台线程中提前检索一个分片，而消费者处理当前分片，从而使活动分片载荷的数量相对于总数据集大小保持有界。异步预取和有界缓冲是既定的系统技术，而非新颖的调度算法。FoldPipe的贡献在于一个针对原生.pt分子分片的小型集成，以及对其运行范围的源固定实证表征。我们使用Tesla T4上的MD17阿司匹林数据集，通过20次成对、顺序交替的基准测试，评估了SchNet能量和力工作负载。每次处理包含五个固定分片。
tldr: FoldPipe通过后台异步预取和有界缓冲，实现了对原生分子分片的远程流式处理，在内存受限环境下高效训练分子模型，其核心贡献是轻量集成与实证表征。
en_tdlr: FoldPipe enables bounded remote streaming of native molecular shards via asynchronous prefetch and bounded buffering, facilitating efficient molecular model training under memory constraints, with its core contribution being lightweight integration and empirical characterization.
